phrases.latin: pater autem, post eum stāns et in speculō spectāns, id perfēcit quod puer coeperat
phrases.english: Dad, standing behind him and watching in the mirror, finished what the boy had begun

sources: Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word.
The example sentence marked “composed” is ours.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 167, each phrase checked against the searchable text of the book.
